item.title: Handing out Alabama transfer portal superlatives
item.description: With the transfer portal now closed, Alabama’s offseason transactions are beginning to slow down. To date, the Crimson Tide lost 21 players to the portal while bringing in 18 scholarship transfers into the program. Before Alabama puts the finishing touches on next season’s roster, here are a few transfer portal superlatives from this year’s cycle.
